content: At-a-glance status (verified WCAG 1.4.1): color must never be the only visual means of conveying status; pair hue with label text and/or icon; luminance contrast 3:1 counts as additional distinction. Glanceable dashboards lead with next-action (next run), then recent history (runs with status), then health; tabular numerals for counts; cards as the mobile unit of information instead of tables.
